scope: Node controller unit tests with minimal DOM and transport fixtures; no real browser, original drafting or image rendering exercised

checks.name: public parameter setter notifies dirty-state consumer
chest/hip ease is separate from waistband ease
current values match the rendered input fixture
invalid API request rejected without corrupting prior values
blank numeric input remains invalid instead of silently becoming zero
blank numeric input cannot reach original drafting callback
drafting disables parameters and both ease inputs
drafting disables ease presets and reset
API cannot mutate in-flight source request
obsolete drafting rejection cannot overwrite new selection feedback
old generation does not leave new editor stuck busy
old source values cannot leak into new source selection
late source load cannot replace newer source fields
read-original operation can reset variant fields without restarting the editor
conditional controls show explicit verified activation dependencies
reset event is not mistaken for a source parameter request
obsolete source read error does not mutate active selection
